blocks.text: Why your client health check template needs to live on your Mac

Most customer success associates struggle with fragmented data. You have your CRM, your support inbox, and your internal notes. None of these talk to each other. When you need to run a health check, you spend half an hour just gathering the numbers. This is where your Mac becomes a tool for focus. By centralizing your workflow, you cut out the noise.
Building a better client health check template

Start by defining what health looks like for your specific accounts. Is it usage frequency? Is it support ticket volume? Maybe it is the time since the last QBR. Create a template in Notion or a spreadsheet that pulls these metrics into one row. Do not try to track everything. Track the things that actually signal churn risk.

blocks.text: How to use Lazur to speed up your daily admin

Lazur lives in your Mac menu bar. It watches your screen only when you tell it to. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on your screen. If you are stuck in a complex CRM dashboard, ask Lazur where the report button is. It draws a circle around the button for you. You never have to hunt through menus again.
Managing email without losing your mind

Email is the biggest drain on your day. You spend 2.6 hours on it daily. That is a lot of time lost to context switching. Use keyboard shortcuts in your email client to archive or move messages fast. If you use Mimestream or Apple Mail, learn the native shortcuts. Lazur can help you draft replies by voice. Hold fn to start dictating and let it format the text for you.

As a customer success associate, you handle sensitive information. Always follow your company guidelines for data privacy. Do not put clear-text passwords or private personal data into AI tools. Lazur processes your screen and audio locally and does not store your data. It is a helper, not a database.

blocks.text: The power of voice dictation for CS notes

After a client call, you have a pile of notes. Typing them out takes forever. Use the dictation feature in Lazur to turn your spoken thoughts into clean, formatted text. Just hold fn and speak. You can even use snippets for common phrases like 'next steps' or 'customer feedback'. This turns a 15 minute admin task into a 2 minute job.

faq.question: Can Lazur fill out my CRM forms for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or interact with web forms directly. It helps you find the right input field and can dictate text into it, but you are in control.

faq.question: Is my client data safe with Lazur?
faq.answer: Lazur does not store your screenshots or audio. It processes them on the fly to answer your questions and then discards them. It is designed for privacy on your Mac.

faq.question: Does this work with my specific CRM?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any app on your Mac. It does not need a special integration with Salesforce, HubSpot, or any other tool. It sees what you see.
